instruct: Calder base narrator: mature Australian-English literary audiobook delivery, grounded, measured, observant, and restrained. Read slowly and with complete command of the sentence. Let punctuation and paragraph turns breathe. Prepare the emotional intention of the next sentence before beginning it. Character color is temporary and must never alter the narrator's underlying pitch center, resonance, cadence, or accent placement. Keep the performance intimate, never sing-song, hesitant, childish, Americanized, or announcer-like.
baseResetInstruct: BASE NARRATOR RESET. Begin from the locked neutral reference, not from the previous take. Restore the approved narrator's normal pitch center, resonance, cadence, accent placement, and emotional distance. Carry over none of the previous character, action, grief, whisper, urgency, or sentence ending.
